reduceIf.confirmation: A settled 1H CLOSE below 78,000.0 - the same gate midnight set, deliberately unchanged because it survived two tests. It is 306.7 points under spot, 0.96 hourly ATRs on the 319.11 reading, and it sits beneath the 78,181.6 session low and the entire 78,200-78,400 shelf where 176,773 USD of long-side liquidations have been measured in the last 104 minutes. Below 78,000 there is no structure until the 4H EMA100 at 77,459.84 and then the 03 September low at 76,963.2 - an air pocket of roughly 850 points. A settled close through it triggers the SECOND and larger trim; this session already took the first.

addIf.confirmation: A settled 1H CLOSE above 78,810.0. That is 503.3 points over spot and it reclaims the 1H EMA20 at 78,801.23, which price has now closed under for nine consecutive hours. The gate was lowered from midnight's 79,000.0 because that level has already been resolved: the 10:00 UTC candle printed a high of 78,999.9, missing the trigger by one tenth of a point, and settled 438.0 points lower at 78,561.9. A rejection that precise does not need re-testing to be believed - what needs proving now is the hourly EMA20, and nothing above it matters until price closes back over it.

decisionBox.changed: Position moves from midnight's ADD to REDUCE, and the wallet acted on it. Midnight left one instruction for this session: size is decided by open interest, not price - if it has FALLEN the flush finished overnight and the second tranche is earned, if it is still RISING keep sitting on the cash no matter how oversold the oscillators look. It is still rising. Open interest is 2,217,046,617 USD, up 1.61 percent from midnight's 2,181,931,888 while price fell 119.5 points; funding has gone from +0.0000469742 to +0.0000601863, up 28.1 percent; and the 1H long/short account ratio has walked 1.21 to 1.27, the highest of the week and the fourth consecutive session it has risen. That is a fourth straight session of leverage being added long into weakness, so the add is refused and a 12 percent trim of the spot core is taken instead to rebuild ammunition ahead of a reduce gate that is only 306.7 points away. Gates: reduce unchanged at 78,000.0, add lowered from 79,000.0 to 78,810.0, invalidation moved from 77,421.83 to 77,459.84 as the 4H EMA100 drifted up.

This is measured realized-liquidation data, not an estimate. It is also the single most important change since midnight: at 02:08 COT every one of the 100 fills in the window was a long being closed, and the book is now two-sided. The fuel above has been consumed once already, which is why price could not hold it.

The new row is 08 September 2026 and every issuer cell is a dash with a 0.0 total - a placeholder for today's session, not a print. The confirmed record still ends at 04 September +174.6m (IBIT +117.4m, FBTC +57.2m), preceded by 03 September +730.8m, 02 September +101.1m and 01 September -236.5m. Streak = 3 consecutive net-inflow days. There is no 07 September row at all because Monday was Labor Day in the United States and the creation and redemption channel was shut. Today is the reopen: the first new print in five calendar days lands after the US close. So BTC has now spent five sessions with neither an institutional bid nor an institutional seller, and the entire 818-point round trip of the last five hours happened inside that vacuum. It is a leverage move, not a flow move, and that is exactly why it can reverse the moment the channel reopens.

liquidations.note: MEASURED, and for the first time this week it is TWO-SIDED. The rolling 100-fill OKX BTC-USDT-SWAP window spans 104 minutes, 10:20:18 to 12:04:38 UTC, and splits 35 buy-side fills against 65 sell-side: 823,638 USD of shorts liquidated at 78,859.1-78,959.2 on the run to 78,999.9, and 176,773 USD of longs liquidated at 78,196.3-78,520.7 on the way back down. The positioning underneath it has not improved at all - it has got worse for a fourth straight session. Open interest is 2,217,046,617 USD, UP 1.61 percent from midnight's 2,181,931,888 while price fell 119.5 points, so roughly 35.1 million dollars of notional was ADDED into a decline. Funding is +0.0000601863, up 28.1 percent from +0.0000469742. The 1H long/short account ratio is 1.27 against 1.21 at midnight and 1.16 at end of day - the highest of the week. Longs are being liquidated and immediately replaced at a worse price. The skew field carries the account ratio, and above 1.00 it means the crowd is long and the vulnerable side is down.

calibration.rollingRecord: 8 of the last 12 resolved sessions marked acting_helped true. The last three failures - 06 September morning, 07 September end of day and now 08 September midnight - all share one cause: a spot tranche added while open interest was still rising.
calibration.note: Both midnight gates correctly REFUSED, and one of them by a margin that is hard to believe. The 78,000.0 reduce gate required a settled 1H close below the level; across five hours the lowest settled hourly close was 78,306.9 and the lowest low 78,181.6, so price came within 181.6 points of the trigger and turned away twice. The 79,000.0 add gate required a settled close above; the 10:00 UTC candle printed a high of 78,999.9 - one tenth of a point short - and settled 438.0 points lower at 78,561.9. The 77,421.83 invalidation was never approached. So a trader who followed the gates did nothing for five hours and is flat, which was the correct outcome for a session that ended 119.5 points from where it started. The discretionary side is marked false, narrowly. Midnight spent 5.00 of its 24.66 USDT at 78,426.2 and price marks 78,306.7, so the tranche is 119.5 points offside, -0.15 percent, roughly -0.0076 USDT. Its own stated condition for the NEXT tranche was that open interest had to fall; it has instead risen 1.61 percent to 2,217,046,617 USD while funding rose 28.1 percent and the account ratio went 1.21 to 1.27. Midnight was right to shrink the size and right to write the condition down - the 19.66 USDT it protected is what this session is now trading with.
